mapper.sql: id, account, password_hash, real_name, role, status, must_change_password, phone, token_version, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_time, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE account = #{account}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (account, password_hash, real_name, role, status, phone, must_change_password, token_version, login_fail_count) VALUES (#{account}, #{passwordHash}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{status}, #{phone}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{tokenVersion}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, token_version = #{tokenVersion}, must_change_password = #{mustChangePassword}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: AND (account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT FROM sys_user
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
